notes.title: Build 10 Release Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25807417/1886f4a1378836024f566051fddafe85e439a6ca.jpg[/img]
Since the end of 2016 we’ve focused on making the world more real, more alive.  While not all these features are ready for release, you will see hints and starts of the deeper realism and complex systems that will make Archmage Rises a truly unique RPG experience.

We’ve also implemented our more stringent testing process (using test cases and Steam discussion bug checklists).  This resulted in 30+ bugs found and fixed.  So while we cannot promise perfection, this is the most stable reliable version of the game yet!

https://youtu.be/VqwaAm90JS0

[h1]Sorry, but you will lose your save file![/h1]

Also, the way to explore a hex is to walk to it then click the Map icon in the top right to close the map.  This will "display" the hex allowing you to interact with it.  For now there is nothing in the hexes unless a noble tells you about it.

[h1]Major:[/h1]
[olist]
[*]New day night cycle and weather system.  Day night currently doesn’t have game impact, weather has some.  More to come.
[*]New hex exploration.  Before you can enter a dungeon/ruins you must find it!  Every hex can now be explored.  Any successful exploration will reveal the dungeon location.  This is the first part of a larger system not yet fully implemented.  Don’t waste your time exploring non-dungeon hexes, there is nothing yet to find.
[*]Dungeons are now populated by specific races, not random.  This also ties into a larger system to come.
[*]Save file compatibility check on title screen.  Sorry, but you will lose your save file with this version.  This will likely be true for all major new versions.
[*]Can save from anywhere (except combat).
[*]Trade deal system.  Graphical display of products merchant is buying/selling, the ability to make a trade on a group of items in one go and to negotiate discounts/increases on the transaction using persuasion skill.
[*]Merchants work outside, so if it’s raining they are in a bad mood, and if in a bad mood negotiating is harder
[*]Requested feature: ability to sell off goods you no longer want.  Choose the Divest button to sell them to anyone at a steep discount.  Everyone loves a deal.
[*]Persuasion is the first of new skill features with limited uses (or charges).  A good rest (66% chance) will recharge these skills.  A notification will tell you when they are recharged.
[*]NPCs now move around the town, visiting various buildings. you can see and interact with them. It is possible to meet the entire town population this way (eventually).  This is the start of much more features to come.
[*]New feature to Question NPC’s, removed the old talk/trait system for now.  Ask them why they are in their current location, who’s in their family, and their birthday!  This is groundwork for more features.
[*]New town events: fires, peasant revolts, new building construction, and more.  This causes buildings to be closed, inventories to be wiped, new buildings to open, reaction to plagues, etc.  You can see what events are currently happening by asking for Local News at the Inn.  More visibility and control of these coming.
[*]Lowered difficulty curve over time.  We thought people would play a few months to get a feel of the game, but those who enjoy it play more and it eventually became impossible.  Cut the difficulty increase by 50%.
[*]+/- keys zoom on map and tower, for those without a mouse wheel
[*] On Tower screen WASD and Arrow Keys will scroll
[/olist]

[h1]Minor:[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Some new artwork
[*]Continuing a game no longer shows intro 
[*]Since version 9.1 we added new inventory categorization: gear, goods, books, etc.  Items are transferred to mage tower by category, storage is by category
[*]Loading screens snuck into version 9.2, now they are better and actually cover everything :-)
[/olist]

[h1]Bugs fixed:[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed all reported bugs related to save games: Problems with dungeons, quest completion, inventory, book studying, and more were due to buggy file loading.
[*] Fixed difficult to see dungeon navigation links.
[*] Numerous small fixes.
[/olist]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[b]All[/b]
[olist]
[*]There are bugs when ending a game (dying) going to title screen and starting a new game.  As a workaround the game quits upon death and saving, you have to start it up again to continue.  Sorry.
[*]No game balancing changes (other than the curve mentioned above), so prices, treasures, etc. are just as good/bad as before.
[/olist]

[b]Mac[/b]
[olist]
[*]Hit detection on map cells is still off in 16:10 resolutions. Sorry, will fix soon.
[*]Dungeon navigation sometimes unseeable still not fixed, artist hasn't got to it yet.
[/olist]

See how a veteran RPG game designer is longing and calling for a new RPG experience.  One that Archmage Rises delivers.

notes.title: Build 9.2 Released!
notes.notes:
[i]EDIT: Just noticed you start with 0 gold.  While not crippling, you are supposed to start with 200-500 gold.  Will investigate more on Monday.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25807417/542e51180923d65c63a84f7d758332deee0752ef.jpg[/img]
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed game saving issues: losing items, goods, quest items
[*]Fixed inventory issues: things like quest item not going into inventory
[*]Roads are generated with a better algorithm based on wealth & distance; not finished yet.
[*]A very early version of the timeline appears below the date, showing quests and when expenses are due.
[*]Fixed around 25 other bugs. Introduced 24 new ones. So we're ahead by 1!
[*]First version of loading screens, not done yet but it works
[*]Greatly improved map performance, went from 60->180fps on dev machines
[*]Merchant now tells what goods are needed in the town
[*]When town reaches max on a good, merchant tells you so and it is removed from your sell list option
[/list]

[h1]Known issues: [/h1]
[b]All:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]ONLY SAVE AND QUIT FROM TOWNS[/b]. If you do it elsewhere (like a desert hex) it won't work.  This is due to a missing artwork issue.
[*][b]Ideal and most tested resolution is 1920x1080[/b]
[*]There is an issue when double clicking buttons, cards.  Just single click and you'll be ok
[/list]
[b]Mac: [/b]
[list]
[*]Navigation in dungeons is still bad in 16:10 aspect ratios. Need art adjustments and the artist is on vacation, sorry.
[*]Map in 16:10 has really terrible hex cursor detection.  Like the worst. Ooops.  We'll fix this too.
[/list]

Unless we did something catastrophic, this is the last build for a while as we focus on lots of new features.

See the video updates for new features, when builds are coming, and latest on the official dev blog:
[url=http://www.archmagerises.com/news]http://www.archmagerises.com/news[/url]

[*]Greatly improved map performance, went from 60->180fps on dev machines
[*]Merchant now tells what goods are needed in the town
[*]When town reaches max on a good, merchant tells you so and it is removed from your sell list option
[/list]

[h1]Known issues: [/h1]
[b]All:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]ONLY SAVE AND QUIT FROM TOWNS[/b]. If you do it elsewhere (like a desert hex) it won't work.  This is due to a missing artwork issue.
[*][b]Ideal and most tested resolution is 1920x1080[/b]
[*]There is an issue when double clicking buttons, cards.  Just single click and you'll be ok
[/list]
[b]Mac: [/b]
[list]
[*]Navigation in dungeons is still bad in 16:10 aspect ratios. Need art adjustments and the artist is on vacation, sorry.
[*]Map in 16:10 has really terrible hex cursor detection.  Like the worst. Ooops.  We'll fix this too.

notes.title: Build 9 Mage Tower Released!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25807417/4d1f380f0d07fa3faeae511800af0b76bd85592c.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Late breaking: Mac version has problems loading a game, we're working on it![/i][/b]

We’re excited to release some great new features to Archmage Rises today!  We’ve worked hard to plumb in the new systems, and create a bit of content for them.  Hopefully this build will give a better idea of what the final game will be like, but there is still plenty more to come!

Watch this video update to see the new version:

https://youtu.be/1sDgUgdyVU0

[h1]New Features/Additions[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Mage Tower – after buying or persuading a noble for land, you can build your own mage tower.  Limited blocks, rooms, roofs, and decorations for now.  More content to come.
[*]Save / Continue game – you no longer have to play a whole game in a single sitting!  Save the game whenever you quit and continue from the title screen.  If you die, your save file is deleted and you must start a new life.
[*]Better Dungeons – better map generation, better object placement, a few new rooms, easier skill checks, some new artwork.  More content to come.
[*]Twenty Sided Dice (d20s) – behind the scenes it was using d20 rolls to determine success/fail, now we show you the actual roll.  And the rolls are real and physics based.  Currently used in skill checks and crafting, more to come.  Playing with actual dice will be an optional feature for those who just want RNG.
[*]Crafting – We’ve put in a basic crafting system for potion making.  Successes level up skills making it easier to craft in the future.  Rolling a 20 is a critical success resulting in 2 potions for one herb instead of just 1.
[*]Basic economy and trading - The dynamic economy (trading with merchants) isn’t done yet, but we decided to release it anyway because it is needed for the mage tower features.  18 trade goods are simulated in the economy with pricing based on supply and demand.
[*]Draft Animals – The amount of trade goods you can carry at any given time is determined by the total strength of you and your draft animals (carts are assumed).  Right now only the monthly cost and strength matter: speed and defense ability will matter soon.  Ability to name your own animals still to come.
[*]Treasury – All monthly expenses are paid from your treasury.  This is like asking your neighbor or employee to pay your bill in your absence.  If your treasury has insufficient funds you go to debtor’s prison (currently game ending, but won’t be in the future).
[*]Storage – You can now store items in your mage tower, and manage what you carry.  Build storage rooms to increase capacity.  More depth coming to this in the future.
[*]Buffs moved – we moved all buffs (good and bad) to be at the bottom of the screen and show in chronological order.  Mouse over them to see current effect. 
[/olist]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[olist]
[*]No loading screens between transitions, it just hangs, but it does actually load the next scene
[*]Distribution of buildings in towns is still not right, may get doubles of the same building, distribution of all building types still not right, and based on randomness some may be too rare in any given game
[*]When rolling dice, sometimes reports a value different than what you see due to it stopping on an angle.  You will get more success and failures than you should, balancing out even.  Will fix in the next major version, it’s fairly rare but does happen.
[*]On Mac or 16:10 screen resolutions the dungeon east/west navigation areas are hard to see, but just put the mouse there and click, it does work
[/olist]

[h1]Next Build[/h1]
Build 10 coming end of Jan.  This one will be a content build fleshing out many of the systems we already have in place.  More info on what it contains will be posted after Christmas.

Let us know in the steam discussions what you guys think of this build!

notes.title: Mac Version 8.1 Now Available!
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce the mac version of Archmage Rises is now available.  To release it I also had to send up a build of the windows version.  It is the same windows version, nothing new for windows.  I don't think any windows people will see an Update to download, but if you do, sorry nothing is updated.

I bought a macbook air 13.3" with 1440 x 900 (16:10) screen to test the mac version.  It runs well on my mac at that resolution.  If you have a mac and encounter issues, please report them with screenshots if possible so we can address it.

The best resolution to run the game at right now is 1920x1080 (16:9)  if you have that as an option.

Going forward the Mac and PC version are the same code base (thank you Unity) so all future updates will be to both platforms.

Known issues:
[list]
[*] In 16:10 resolution there are some graphical glitches at the top and bottom of the dungeon screen.  We are aware of it and fixing it in the next release.
[*] Performance on the test mac is 100 fps in town and combat, 30fps on the map and dungeon.  We're still working on performance improvements to help run on older hardware.
[*] There is a slight pause when you change hexes on the map.  We're working on removing this.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 8.1 Now Live
notes.notes:
Since the initial release Aug 3, a number of bugs have been reported and fixed.  I'm sorry I don't have a complete list of what was fixed.  Here is what I know:

[list]
[*]Now press ESC to get a placeholder menu allowing you to quit. BREAK doesn't work anymore.
[*] Massive performance improvements for those on low end machines.  
[*] Doubled map size for performance testing.  It will be much larger in the real game.
[*] Fixed town crashing, launch crashing, and sometimes exit dungeon crashing.
[*] Oh, and the build still says 8.0 even though it is 8.1.  Never trust a build released on a Friday! ːsteamhappyː
[/list]
